requirements.subject: ent:signature-template
requirements.canonical: A signature parameter of a signature template SHALL NOT be referenced directly (e.g. using dot notation), except when modifying the signature template.
requirements.original: While signature templates do not allow referencing their parameters directly (e.g. using dot notation), such a reference is possible when modifying a signature template.

requirements.subject: ent:modified-template
requirements.canonical: A modified signature template MAY reference a signature parameter of its parent signature template.
requirements.original: While signature templates do not allow referencing their parameters directly (e.g. using dot notation), such a reference is possible when modifying a signature template.

requirements.subject: ent:matching-mechanism
requirements.canonical: A matching mechanism CAN be assigned to a signature template as a whole.
requirements.original: However, there can be a matching mechanism assigned to the signature template.

requirements.subject: ent:signature-parameter
requirements.condition: a template list or complemented list is assigned to the signature template; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: Referencing a signature parameter of a signature template to which a template list or a complemented list is assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, SHALL cause an error.
requirements.original: a) Value lists and complemented lists: referencing a parameter of a signature template to which a value list or a complemented list is assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, shall cause an error.

ambiguity.issue: "Value list" is used where the matching mechanism is called template list in clause B.1.2.1.

requirements.subject: ent:signature-template
requirements.condition: AnyValue is assigned to the signature template; parameter referenced on the left hand side of an assignment
requirements.canonical: When a signature parameter of a signature template to which AnyValue is assigned is referenced at the left hand side of an assignment, the signature template IS implicitly expanded to the parameter level.
requirements.original: b) _AnyValue: when referencing a parameter within a signature to which AnyValue is assigned, at the left hand_ side of an assignment, the signature template is implicitly expanded to the parameter level.

ambiguity.issue: "within a signature" is used where the signature template is meant.

requirements.subject: ent:signature-template
requirements.condition: AnyValue is assigned to the signature template; parameter referenced on the left hand side of an assignment
requirements.canonical: During the implicit expansion of a signature template to which AnyValue is assigned, AnyValue SHALL be assigned to all signature parameters of the template.
requirements.original: During this expansion an AnyValue shall be assigned to all parameters of the template. b) _AnyValue: when referencing a parameter within a signature to which AnyValue is assigned, at the left hand_ side of an assignment, the signature template is implicitly expanded to the parameter level.

requirements.subject: ent:signature-parameter
requirements.condition: AnyValue is assigned to the signature template; parameter referenced on the left hand side of an assignment
requirements.canonical: After the implicit expansion of the signature template, the value or matching mechanism at the right hand side of the assignment SHALL be assigned to the referenced signature parameter.
requirements.original: After this expansion the value or matching mechanism at the right hand side of the assignment shall be assigned to the referenced parameter. b) _AnyValue: when referencing a parameter within a signature to which AnyValue is assigned, at the left hand_ side of an assignment, the signature template is implicitly expanded to the parameter level.

requirements.subject: ent:template
requirements.canonical: A template or a template variable MAY reference an alternative inside a union template using the dot notation.
requirements.original: Both templates and template variables allow referencing alternatives inside a union template definition using the dot notation.

requirements.subject: ent:matching-mechanism
requirements.canonical: A referenced union alternative CAN belong to a template field to which a matching mechanism is assigned.
requirements.original: However, the referenced alternative may belong to template field containing a matching mechanism.

requirements.subject: ent:union-alternative
requirements.condition: omit, AnyValueOrNone, template list or complemented list assigned; reference on the right hand side
requirements.canonical: Referencing an alternative of a union template or template field to which `omit`, AnyValueOrNone, a template list or a complemented list is assigned, at the right hand side of an assignment, SHALL cause an error.
requirements.original: a) _Omit, AnyValueOrNone, template lists and complemented lists: referencing an alternative of a union template_ or template field to which Omit, AnyValueOrNone, a template list or a complemented list is assigned, at the right hand side of an assignment, shall cause an error.

requirements.subject: ent:union-template
requirements.condition: AnyValueOrNone or omit is assigned to the union template or template field; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: When an alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValueOrNone or `omit` is assigned is referenced at the left hand side of an assignment, the template field IS implicitly set to be present.
requirements.original: When referencing an alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValueOrNone or Omit is assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, the template field is implicitly set to be present and the referenced alternative becomes the chosen one.

requirements.subject: ent:union-alternative
requirements.condition: AnyValueOrNone or omit is assigned to the union template or template field; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: When an alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValueOrNone or `omit` is assigned is referenced at the left hand side of an assignment, the referenced alternative IS made the chosen alternative.
requirements.original: When referencing an alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValueOrNone or Omit is assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, the template field is implicitly set to be present and the referenced alternative becomes the chosen one.

requirements.subject: ent:union-alternative
requirements.condition: AnyValueOrNone or omit is assigned to the union template or template field; reference on the left hand side; the referenced alternative is not the last element of the dot notation
requirements.canonical: If the referenced alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValueOrNone or `omit` is assigned is not the last element of the dot notation, the rules of clause 15.6.2 for AnyValue SHALL apply recursively for further expansion.
requirements.original: If the referenced alternative is not the last element of the dot notation, rules in clause 15.6.2 valid for AnyValue shall apply recursively for further expansion. When referencing an alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValueOrNone or Omit is assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, the template field is implicitly set to be present and the referenced alternative becomes the chosen one.

requirements.subject: ent:union-alternative
requirements.condition: AnyValueOrNone or omit is assigned to the union template or template field; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: After the expansion of a union template or template field to which AnyValueOrNone or `omit` is assigned, the value or matching mechanism at the right hand side of the assignment SHALL be assigned to the referenced subfield.
requirements.original: After this expansion the value or matching mechanism at the right hand side of the assignment shall be assigned to the referenced subfield. When referencing an alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValueOrNone or Omit is assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, the template field is implicitly set to be present and the referenced alternative becomes the chosen one.

requirements.subject: ent:union-alternative
requirements.condition: template list or complemented list assigned; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: Referencing an alternative of a union template field to which a template list or a complemented list is assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, SHALL cause an error.
requirements.original: Referencing an alternative of a union template field to which template lists or complemented template lists are assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, shall cause an error.

ambiguity.issue: The sentence names only a "union template field", while item a) otherwise covers "union template or template field"; it is unclear whether a union template (not a field) with a template list is also covered.
readings: Referencing an alternative of a union template or union template field to which a template list or complemented list is assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, SHALL cause an error.

Referencing an alternative of a union template field (but not of a top-level union template) to which a template list or complemented list is assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, SHALL cause an error.

requirements.subject: ent:union-alternative
requirements.condition: AnyValue assigned; reference on the right hand side
requirements.canonical: When an alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValue is assigned is referenced at the right hand side of an assignment, the reference SHALL return AnyValue.
requirements.original: b) _AnyValue: when referencing an alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValue is_ assigned, at the right hand side of an assignment, AnyValue shall be returned.

requirements.subject: ent:union-alternative
requirements.condition: AnyValue assigned to the union template or template field; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: When an alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValue is assigned is referenced at the left hand side of an assignment, the referenced alternative IS made the chosen alternative.
requirements.original: When referencing an alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValue is assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, the referenced alternative becomes the chosen one.

requirements.subject: ent:union-alternative
requirements.condition: AnyValue assigned to the union template or template field; reference on the left hand side; the referenced alternative is not the last element of the dot notation
requirements.canonical: If the referenced alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValue is assigned is not the last element of the dot notation, the rules of clause 15.6.2 for AnyValue SHALL apply recursively for further expansion.
requirements.original: If the referenced alternative is not the last element of the dot notation, rules in clause 15.6.2 valid for AnyValue shall apply recursively for further expansion. When referencing an alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValue is assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, the referenced alternative becomes the chosen one.

requirements.subject: ent:union-alternative
requirements.condition: AnyValue assigned to the union template or template field; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: After the expansion of a union template or template field to which AnyValue is assigned, the value or matching mechanism at the right hand side of the assignment SHALL be assigned to the referenced subfield.
requirements.original: After this expansion the value or matching mechanism at the right hand side of the assignment shall be assigned to the referenced subfield. When referencing an alternative of a union template or template field to which AnyValue is assigned, at the left hand side of an assignment, the referenced alternative becomes the chosen one.

requirements.subject: ent:union-alternative
requirements.condition: the ifpresent attribute is attached to the union template field
requirements.canonical: Referencing an alternative of a union template field to which the `ifpresent` attribute is attached SHALL cause an error, irrespective of the value or matching mechanism to which `ifpresent` is appended.
requirements.original: c) Ifpresent attribute: referencing an alternative of a union template field to which the ifpresent attribute is attached, shall cause an error (irrespective of the value or the matching mechanism to which ifpresent is appended).

requirements.subject: ent:union-alternative
requirements.condition: the address type is a union type and its actual value is null
requirements.canonical: Referencing an alternative of an address type whose actual value is `null` SHALL cause an error.
requirements.original: d) Special value null: referencing an alternative of an address type, which actual value is null shall cause an error.

requirements.subject: ent:template
requirements.canonical: A template or a template variable MAY reference an element of a map template or field using the index notation.
requirements.original: Both templates and template variables allow referencing elements of a map template or field using the index notation.

requirements.subject: ent:matching-mechanism
requirements.canonical: A matching mechanism CAN be assigned to the map template or field within which an element is referenced.
requirements.original: However, a matching mechanism may be assigned to the template or field within which the element is referenced.

requirements.subject: ent:map-element
requirements.condition: omit is assigned to the map template or field
requirements.canonical: Referencing an element within a map template or field to which `omit` is assigned SHALL follow the rules specified in clause 6.2.15.7.
requirements.original: a) _Omit: referencing an element within a map to which omit is assigned shall follow the rules specified in_ clause 6.2.15.7.

ambiguity.issue: "within a map" is used where a map template or field is meant (omit cannot be assigned to a map value).

requirements.subject: ent:map-element
requirements.condition: a template list or complemented list is assigned
requirements.canonical: Referencing an element within a map template or field to which a template list or a complemented list is assigned SHALL cause an error.
requirements.original: b) Template lists and complemented lists: referencing an element within a map field to which a list or complemented list is assigned, shall cause an error.

ambiguity.issue: "list" is used for template list, and "map field" is used although Example 1 applies the rule to a map template variable.

requirements.subject: ent:map-element
requirements.condition: AnyValue assigned; reference on the right hand side
requirements.canonical: When an element of a map template or field to which AnyValue is assigned is referenced at the right hand side of an assignment, the reference SHALL return AnyValueOrNone.
requirements.original: c) _AnyValue: when referencing an element of a map template or field to which AnyValue is assigned, at the_ right- hand side of an assignment, AnyValueOrNone shall be returned.

requirements.subject: ent:map-template
requirements.condition: AnyValue assigned to the map template or field; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: When an element of a map template or field to which AnyValue is assigned is referenced at the left hand side of an assignment, the template or field IS implicitly expanded recursively up to and including the depth of the referenced subfield.
requirements.original: When referencing an element within a map template or field to which AnyValue is assigned, at the left-hand side of an assignment, the template or field is implicitly expanded recursively up to and including, the depth of the referenced subfield and AnyValue is assigned to the referenced field.

requirements.subject: ent:map-element
requirements.condition: AnyValue assigned to the map template or field; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: When an element of a map template or field to which AnyValue is assigned is referenced at the left hand side of an assignment, AnyValue IS assigned to the referenced field during the implicit expansion.
requirements.original: When referencing an element within a map template or field to which AnyValue is assigned, at the left-hand side of an assignment, the template or field is implicitly expanded recursively up to and including, the depth of the referenced subfield and AnyValue is assigned to the referenced field.

requirements.subject: ent:map-element
requirements.condition: AnyValue assigned to the map template or field; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: After the implicit expansion of a map template or field to which AnyValue is assigned, the value or matching mechanism at the right hand side of the assignment SHALL be assigned to the referenced field.
requirements.original: Then the value or matching mechanism at the right-hand side of the assignment shall be assigned to the referenced field and _AnyElementsOrNone shall be added to the map template._ When referencing an element within a map template or field to which AnyValue is assigned, at the left-hand side of an assignment, the template or field is implicitly expanded recursively up to and including, the depth of the referenced subfield and AnyValue is assigned to the referenced field.

requirements.subject: ent:map-template
requirements.condition: AnyValue assigned to the map template or field; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: After the assignment to an element of a map template or field to which AnyValue was assigned, AnyElementsOrNone SHALL be added to the map template.
requirements.original: Then the value or matching mechanism at the right-hand side of the assignment shall be assigned to the referenced field and _AnyElementsOrNone shall be added to the map template._ When referencing an element within a map template or field to which AnyValue is assigned, at the left-hand side of an assignment, the template or field is implicitly expanded recursively up to and including, the depth of the referenced subfield and AnyValue is assigned to the referenced field.

requirements.subject: ent:map-element
requirements.condition: AnyValueOrNone assigned; reference on the right hand side
requirements.canonical: Referencing an element within a map template or field to which AnyValueOrNone is assigned at the right hand side of an assignment SHALL cause an error.
requirements.original: d) _AnyValueOrNone: referencing an element within a map template or field to which AnyValueOrNone is_ assigned on the right-hand side of an assignment shall cause an error.

requirements.subject: ent:map-element
requirements.condition: AnyValueOrNone assigned; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: When an element within a map template or field to which AnyValueOrNone is assigned is referenced at the left hand side of an assignment, the rules for AnyValue (item c) of clause 15.6.6) SHALL apply.
requirements.original: When referencing an element within a map template or field to which AnyValueOrNone is assigned on the left-hand side of an assignment, the rules for AnyValue shall apply (see item c) for more details).

requirements.subject: ent:map-element
requirements.condition: the ifpresent attribute is attached
requirements.canonical: Referencing an element within a map template or field to which the `ifpresent` attribute is attached SHALL cause an error, irrespective of the value or matching mechanism to which `ifpresent` is appended.
requirements.original: e) Ifpresent attribute: referencing an element within a map template or field to which the ifpresent attribute is attached, shall cause an error (irrespective of the value or the matching mechanism to which ifpresent is appended).

requirements.subject: ent:map-element
requirements.condition: the map template or field contains AnyElementsOrNone; the referenced element is not present; reference on the right hand side
requirements.canonical: When an element of a map template or field that contains AnyElementsOrNone is referenced at the right hand side of an assignment and the referenced element is not present, the reference SHALL return AnyValueOrNone.
requirements.original: f) _AnyElementsOrNone: when referencing an element of a map template or field that contains_ _AnyElementsOrNone, if the referenced element is not present and the reference occurs on the right-hand side_ of an assignment, AnyValueOrNone shall be returned.

requirements.subject: ent:map-template
requirements.condition: the map template or field contains AnyElementsOrNone; the referenced element is not present; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: When an element that is not present is referenced at the left hand side of an assignment in a map template or field that contains AnyElementsOrNone, the template or field IS implicitly expanded recursively up to and including the depth of the referenced subfield.
requirements.original: When referencing an element of a map template or field that contains AnyElementsOrNone, if the referenced element is not present and the reference occurs on the left-hand side of an assignment, the template or field is implicitly expanded recursively up to and including, the depth of the referenced subfield and AnyValue is assigned to the referenced field.

requirements.subject: ent:map-element
requirements.condition: the map template or field contains AnyElementsOrNone; the referenced element is not present; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: When an element that is not present is referenced at the left hand side of an assignment in a map template or field that contains AnyElementsOrNone, AnyValue IS assigned to the referenced field during the implicit expansion.
requirements.original: When referencing an element of a map template or field that contains AnyElementsOrNone, if the referenced element is not present and the reference occurs on the left-hand side of an assignment, the template or field is implicitly expanded recursively up to and including, the depth of the referenced subfield and AnyValue is assigned to the referenced field.

requirements.subject: ent:map-element
requirements.condition: the map template or field contains AnyElementsOrNone; the referenced element is not present; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: After the implicit expansion of a map template or field that contains AnyElementsOrNone, the value or matching mechanism at the right hand side of the assignment SHALL be assigned to the referenced field.
requirements.original: Then the value or matching mechanism at the right-hand side of the assignment shall be assigned to the referenced field and AnyElementsOrNone shall be added to the map template. When referencing an element of a map template or field that contains AnyElementsOrNone, if the referenced element is not present and the reference occurs on the left-hand side of an assignment, the template or field is implicitly expanded recursively up to and including, the depth of the referenced subfield and AnyValue is assigned to the referenced field.

requirements.subject: ent:map-template
requirements.condition: the map template or field contains AnyElementsOrNone; the referenced element is not present; reference on the left hand side
requirements.canonical: After the assignment to a non-present element of a map template or field that contains AnyElementsOrNone, AnyElementsOrNone SHALL be added to the map template.
requirements.original: Then the value or matching mechanism at the right-hand side of the assignment shall be assigned to the referenced field and AnyElementsOrNone shall be added to the map template. When referencing an element of a map template or field that contains AnyElementsOrNone, if the referenced element is not present and the reference occurs on the left-hand side of an assignment, the template or field is implicitly expanded recursively up to and including, the depth of the referenced subfield and AnyValue is assigned to the referenced field.

ambiguity.issue: The map template already contains AnyElementsOrNone; it is unclear whether a second AnyElementsOrNone is added or the existing one is kept.
readings: The map template SHALL contain AnyElementsOrNone after the assignment (the existing one is kept).
A further AnyElementsOrNone SHALL be added to the map template in addition to the existing one.

requirements.subject: ent:map-element
requirements.condition: the address type is derived from a map type and its actual value is null
requirements.canonical: Referencing an element of an address type that is derived from a map type and whose actual value is `null` SHALL cause an error.
requirements.original: g) Special value null: referencing an element of an address type that is derived from a map type and whose actual value is null shall cause an error.

introductory sentence for rules a) to d)
introductory sentence for rules a) to g)
